commitments.detail: V-12 is authorized for the three 500-kg specialty-coating batches ONLY after all four open items are resolved: (1) Maintenance — parts confirmation received and 5-hour agitator seal replacement completed; (2) EHS — nitrogen purge completed before charging, continuous LEL monitoring throughout first batch, and environmental log attached to gate packet; (3) Quality — customer quality file attached to gate packet, one retained sample per batch, and viscosity testing at 25°C before each batch release; (4) Production Scheduling — batches sequenced to hit the three fixed Friday transfer slots at 06:00, 11:00, and 16:00.

Parts confirmation, 5-hour seal replacement, and nitrogen purge must be sequenced to protect the 06:00 Friday transfer slot as the critical first milestone. If the 06:00 slot cannot realistically be met, the control plan must be revised before final authorization is granted.
Both the environmental log and the customer quality file must be attached to the pre-start gate packet before final authorization is granted.
